stories.title: View Stock Items Grid
acceptance_criteria: Given a Repair Order with one or more Jobs, when the user navigates to the Items tab, then the system displays a grid of all stock items grouped by Job.
Grid columns: Item | Description | Sell Price($) | Disc(%) | Disc($) | QOH | Requested | Extended($) | Committed | Delivered | Outstanding | Total(w/tax)($) | Actions.
Each row shows the item's current quantities and pricing.
Outstanding Qty = Requested - Delivered (persisted, shown in grid).
Actions column shows context-sensitive action buttons per item state.
Items with LineStatus = 'Deleted' are not shown in the grid.
Grid supports sorting by column headers.
Pagination applies when item count exceeds page limit.
stories.narrative: Service technician or parts staff views all stock items added to a Repair Order, grouped by Job. The grid provides a snapshot of item status including quantities and pricing.
stories.design_notes: Grid columns from PDF: Item | Description | Sell Price($) | Disc(%) | Disc($) | QOH | Requested | Extended($) | Committed | Delivered | Outstanding | Total(w/tax)($) | Actions. Items grouped under Job headers. Pagination controls at bottom.

stories.title: Add Stock Item to Repair Order
acceptance_criteria: Given a Repair Order in editable state, when the user clicks Add Item, then an item search/lookup dialog opens.
User can search by item number or description.
Search results show: Item Number, Description, QOH, Price.
When user selects an item and confirms, a RepairOrderItem record is created with RequestedQty=1, CommittedQty=0, DeliveredQty=0, OutstandingQty=1, LineStatus=Active.
If QOH >= RequestedQty, the item is committed automatically (CommittedQty updated via inventory service).
If QOH < RequestedQty, a special order dialog is presented (PHNX-7206 flow).
UnitSellPrice is populated from PriceBook lookup.
SalesPersonUserId defaults to the current Service Advisor.
Toast: 'Item added successfully' on success.
Toast: 'Failed to add item. Please try again.' on error.
stories.narrative: Parts staff or service advisor adds a stock item to a specific Job within the Repair Order. The system performs inventory lookup, quantity validation, and price book lookup.
stories.design_notes: Add Item button in grid toolbar. Item search dialog with search bar and results table: Item Number | Description | QOH | Price. Confirm button triggers add flow. Insufficient QOH triggers special order prompt (see PHNX-7206).
stories.out_of_scope: Adding non-inventory or customer-provided items (separate stories).

stories.title: Manage Service Items (Reserved Items)
acceptance_criteria: Given items have been added to a Repair Order, when the user navigates to Manage Service Items, then a dedicated panel shows all reserved items for the RO.
Panel shows grid: Item | Description | Requested | Committed | Delivered | Outstanding.
User can see which items are fully committed, partially committed, or uncommitted.
User can trigger commit or uncommit actions from this panel.
Panel refreshes after any commit/uncommit/deliver action.
Items with LineStatus = 'Deleted' are excluded from the panel.
stories.narrative: A reserved items / manage service items panel provides an aggregate view of item reservation status across all Jobs in the RO.
stories.design_notes: Dedicated 'Manage Service Items' screen found in PDF. Grid: Item | Description | Requested | Committed | Delivered | Outstanding. Action buttons per row for Commit / Uncommit / Deliver. Panel header shows RO number.

stories.title: Edit Stock Item on Repair Order
acceptance_criteria: Given a stock item exists in the grid, when the user clicks Edit on an item, then an inline edit row or edit panel opens.
Edit fields: Description (max 200 chars) | Sell Price($) | Disc(%) | Disc($) | Requested Qty | Salesperson.
Description field is editable (DR-10: max 200 characters).
Sell Price and Discount fields are editable.
Requested Qty can be increased or decreased, subject to CommittedQty constraint (cannot decrease below CommittedQty).
Salesperson dropdown shows active users.
On Save: record updated, grid refreshes, toast 'Item updated successfully'.
On Cancel: no changes saved.
OCC: if Version mismatch on save, return 409 with message 'Item was modified by another user. Please refresh and try again.'
Delivered items may have restricted edit fields (Sell Price and Discount locked after delivery).
stories.narrative: User edits a stock item's details including description, pricing, discount, and quantity on the Repair Order.
stories.design_notes: Edit grid columns from PDF: Item | Description | Sell Price($) | Disc(%) | Disc($) | Requested | Extended($) | Salesperson. Save and Cancel buttons. Description field max 200 chars shown in validation. OCC 409 error dialog.
stories.out_of_scope: Editing committed/delivered quantities directly (handled via Commit/Deliver flows).

stories.title: Commit Stock Item
acceptance_criteria: Given a stock item with CommittedQty < RequestedQty, when the user clicks Commit, then the system calls inventory service to reserve the quantity.
Sync-first pattern: inventory commit call must succeed before RO record is updated.
On success: CommittedQty updated to RequestedQty, grid refreshes, toast 'Item committed successfully'.
If inventory QOH insufficient: prompt user to create special order (PHNX-7206 flow) or cancel.
OCC enforced: 409 returned if Version mismatch at time of commit.
Bulk commit: if Commit All button is clicked, all uncommitted items for the Job are committed in sequence.
stories.narrative: Committing an item reserves its quantity in the inventory service, ensuring it is set aside for this RO.
stories.design_notes: Commit button per row in Actions column. Commit All button in Job group header. Insufficient QOH shows dialog: 'Insufficient quantity on hand. Create special order?' with Yes/No buttons. Success toast: 'Item committed successfully'.
stories.out_of_scope: Partial commit (commit less than requested quantity).

stories.title: Uncommit Stock Item
acceptance_criteria: Given a stock item with CommittedQty > 0 and DeliveredQty = 0, when the user clicks Uncommit, then the system calls inventory service to release the reservation.
Sync-first pattern: inventory uncommit call must succeed before RO record is updated.
On success: CommittedQty set to 0, grid refreshes, toast 'Item uncommitted successfully'.
Cannot uncommit if DeliveredQty > 0 (partial or full delivery has occurred).
OCC enforced: 409 returned if Version mismatch.
User must confirm: dialog 'Uncommit this item? The reserved quantity will be released.' Confirm / Cancel.
stories.narrative: Uncommitting an item releases the inventory reservation, making the quantity available for other orders.
stories.design_notes: Uncommit button visible in Actions column when CommittedQty > 0 and DeliveredQty = 0. Confirmation dialog: 'Uncommit this item? The reserved quantity will be released.' Confirm / Cancel buttons. Success toast: 'Item uncommitted successfully'.

stories.title: Deliver Stock Item
acceptance_criteria: Given a stock item with CommittedQty > 0, when the user clicks Deliver, then a delivery panel opens.
Delivery panel fields: Delivered To (employee dropdown, required) | Quantity to Deliver (numeric, max = CommittedQty) | Date & Time (auto-filled, editable).
On Deliver: inventory deliver call made first (sync-first); on success DeliveredQty incremented, OutstandingQty decremented, DeliveredToUserId set.
Delivery history table shows previous deliveries: Delivered To | Date & Time | Qty.
Multiple partial deliveries are allowed until DeliveredQty = RequestedQty.
OCC enforced on each delivery.
Toast: 'Item delivered successfully'.
Cannot deliver more than CommittedQty.
stories.narrative: Delivering an item records that physical stock has been handed to a technician or employee, decrementing outstanding quantity.
stories.design_notes: Delivery panel from PDF: 'Delivered To' employee dropdown, Qty field, Date & Time field. Delivery history table: Delivered To | Date & Time | Qty. Confirm Delivery button. Partial delivery allowed. Success toast: 'Item delivered successfully'.

stories.title: Delete Stock Item from Repair Order
acceptance_criteria: Given a stock item with DeliveredQty = 0, when the user clicks Delete, then a confirmation dialog appears.
Confirmation dialog: 'Delete this item? This action cannot be undone.' Delete / Cancel.
On confirm: if CommittedQty > 0, uncommit via inventory service first; then set LineStatus = 'Deleted' (soft delete).
Item disappears from grid after soft delete.
Toast: 'Item deleted successfully'.
Cannot delete if DeliveredQty > 0 — Delete button is disabled or hidden.
For partially delivered items: replace flow must be used instead (PHNX-7196).
OCC enforced: 409 if Version mismatch.
stories.narrative: Deleting an item removes it from the Repair Order view and releases any committed inventory. Soft delete pattern: LineStatus set to 'Deleted'.
stories.design_notes: Delete button in Actions column. Disabled when DeliveredQty > 0. Confirmation dialog: 'Delete this item? This action cannot be undone.' Delete / Cancel. Success toast: 'Item deleted successfully'. Item removed from grid on success.

stories.title: Move Stock Item Between Jobs
acceptance_criteria: Given a stock item exists in one Job, when the user clicks Move, then a Move dialog opens.
Move dialog shows a dropdown of available Jobs on the same RO (excluding current Job).
On confirm: RepairOrderJobId updated to target Job; inventory commit remains unchanged.
Toast: 'Item moved successfully'.
Grid refreshes to show item under new Job grouping.
Cannot move if item has DeliveredQty > 0.
OCC enforced.
stories.narrative: Moving an item reassigns it from one Job to another within the same Repair Order without affecting inventory reservation.
stories.design_notes: Move option in Actions dropdown menu. Dialog: 'Move to Job' with Job selector dropdown. Confirm / Cancel. Grid updates item grouping on success. Toast: 'Item moved successfully'.

stories.title: Create Special Order for Insufficient QOH Item
acceptance_criteria: Given an Add or Commit action results in insufficient QOH, when the user is prompted, then a special order creation dialog opens.
Special order fields: Item (read-only) | Description (read-only) | Note (max 500 chars, optional) | Is Next Day Priority (checkbox) | Requested Qty (editable).
On Create Special Order: IsSpecialOrderLine = true set on RepairOrderItem; RepairSpecialOrderCreated event published to Azure Service Bus.
Event payload: RepairOrderId, RepairOrderItemId, ItemNumber, RequestedQty, IsNextDayPriority, Note, TenantId.
Toast: 'Special order created successfully'.
On Cancel: item added without special order flag (uncommitted).
PHNX-23322 links to this story for the event consumer side.
stories.narrative: When QOH is insufficient to commit an item, the user can create a special order, triggering an event for downstream processing.
stories.design_notes: Special order dialog from PDF: Item (read-only), Description (read-only), Note text area (max 500), Is Next Day Priority checkbox, Requested Qty field. Create Special Order / Cancel buttons. Toast: 'Special order created successfully'.
stories.out_of_scope: Processing the special order downstream (handled by PHNX-23322 consumer).

stories.title: Bulk Actions on Stock Items
acceptance_criteria: Given multiple items are in the grid, when the user selects multiple items via checkboxes, then a bulk action toolbar appears.
Bulk actions available: Commit All | Uncommit All | Delete All.
Commit All: commits all selected uncommitted items; items with insufficient QOH trigger special order prompts per item.
Uncommit All: uncommits all selected committed items with DeliveredQty = 0.
Delete All: deletes all selected items with DeliveredQty = 0 (soft delete each).
Each bulk operation processes items sequentially; errors for individual items are shown inline.
Bulk action summary toast: '{N} items committed successfully. {M} items failed.'
Select All checkbox in grid header selects all eligible items.
stories.narrative: Bulk actions allow parts staff to efficiently process multiple items at once without clicking each row individually.
stories.design_notes: Row checkboxes in grid. Select All checkbox in header. Bulk action toolbar appears when ≥1 item selected: Commit All | Uncommit All | Delete All buttons. Per-item error indicators in grid row. Summary toast on completion.

stories.title: Consume RepairSpecialOrderCreated Event
acceptance_criteria: Given a RepairSpecialOrderCreated event is published, when the downstream consumer receives it, then a purchase request or order is created in the relevant service.
Consumer validates: RepairOrderId, RepairOrderItemId, ItemNumber, RequestedQty must be present.
On success: purchase request created, event acknowledged.
On failure: event goes to dead-letter queue; alert raised.
Idempotency: duplicate event with same RepairOrderItemId is ignored.
Consumer is in tps-dms-repair-order service (or downstream parts service — TBD per HLD note).
stories.narrative: The event consumer side of the special order creation flow, ensuring that a special order triggers procurement in the parts system.
stories.design_notes: No UI screen for this story (async event consumer). AsyncAPI channel: RepairSpecialOrderCreated. Event payload documented in PHNX-7206.
stories.out_of_scope: The actual purchase order creation UI (separate epic).

stories.title: View Stock Item Details Panel
acceptance_criteria: Given a stock item exists in the grid, when the user clicks on the item row or a Details link, then a details panel slides out.

Panel shows all item fields: Item Number, Description, Category, Type, Vendor, Salesperson, all quantity fields, Price, Discount, Note, Special Order flag, Line Status, Created By, Created At, Updated At.
Panel is read-only unless user has edit permission.
Delivery history is shown in the panel if DeliveredQty > 0.
Panel closes on X or clicking outside.
stories.narrative: The details panel provides a full view of all fields on a RepairOrderItem without navigating away from the grid.
stories.design_notes: Slide-out details panel from right side. All RepairOrderItem fields displayed. Delivery history section at bottom if applicable. Close button (X) and overlay click to close.

stories.title: Replace Delivered Stock Item
acceptance_criteria: Given a stock item with DeliveredQty > 0, when the user clicks Replace, then a replace dialog opens.
Replace dialog: current item shown (read-only) | Replacement item search | ReturnedByUserId (employee dropdown, required).
On confirm: current item's LineStatus = 'Deleted', inventory rollback called for CommittedQty; new item added with same RequestedQty.
ReturnedByUserId must be set on the deleted item before replacement.
Toast: 'Item replaced successfully'.
OCC enforced on the delete and create operations.
If replacement item has insufficient QOH: special order flow triggered for new item.
stories.narrative: Replace allows a delivered item to be swapped out, rolling back inventory for the original and committing the replacement.
stories.design_notes: Replace option in Actions dropdown (visible when DeliveredQty > 0). Dialog: Current item display, Replacement item search box, Returned By employee dropdown. Confirm Replace / Cancel. Toast: 'Item replaced successfully'.

stories.title: Add Non-Inventory Item to Repair Order
acceptance_criteria: Given a Repair Order in editable state, when the user clicks Add Non-Inventory Item, then a manual entry form opens.
Form fields: Description (required, max 200 chars) | Category (NI) | UnitSellPrice | DiscountPercent | Requested Qty.
No inventory lookup or commit step for non-inventory items.
ItemCategory = 'NI' on the created record.
No QOH shown for non-inventory items.
Toast: 'Non-inventory item added successfully'.
On Save: RepairOrderItem created with ItemTypeId corresponding to Non-Inventory type.
stories.narrative: Non-inventory items (services, misc charges) can be manually added to a RO without an inventory system lookup.
stories.design_notes: Add Non-Inventory Item option in Add Item dropdown. Manual entry form: Description, Category (auto-set NI), Sell Price, Discount, Qty. No QOH field. Save / Cancel buttons.
stories.out_of_scope: Inventory quantity tracking for non-inventory items.

stories.title: Add Customer-Provided Item to Repair Order
acceptance_criteria: Given a Repair Order in editable state, when the user clicks Add Customer-Provided Item, then a manual entry form opens.
Form fields: Description (required, max 200 chars) | Requested Qty.
No price or discount fields for customer-provided items (UnitSellPrice = NULL).
ItemCategory indicates customer-provided type.
No commit or deliver flow applies to customer-provided items.
Toast: 'Customer-provided item added successfully'.
stories.narrative: Customer-provided items (parts the customer brings in themselves) can be logged on the RO for tracking purposes without price or inventory impact.
stories.design_notes: Add Customer-Provided Item form: Description, Qty only. No price, no discount, no QOH. Save / Cancel. No commit/deliver buttons shown for these items in the grid.
stories.out_of_scope: Pricing or inventory tracking for customer-provided items.

stories.title: Add Digital Item to Repair Order
acceptance_criteria: Given a Repair Order in editable state, when the user clicks Add Digital Item, then a digital item lookup opens.
Digital items are sourced from a separate catalog (DI category).
Form fields: Description | UnitSellPrice | DiscountPercent | Requested Qty.
ItemCategory = 'DI'.
No physical inventory commit required.
Toast: 'Digital item added successfully'.
Digital items appear in the grid alongside physical stock items.
stories.narrative: Digital items (software, digital products) can be added to a RO from a digital product catalog without physical inventory interaction.
stories.design_notes: Add Digital Item option in Add Item dropdown. Digital catalog search. Fields: Description, Sell Price, Discount, Qty. ItemCategory auto-set to DI. No QOH, no commit flow for DI items.
stories.out_of_scope: Digital fulfillment or license key management.

stories.title: Print / Export Stock Items
acceptance_criteria: Given a Repair Order with stock items, when the user clicks Print or Export, then the system generates a formatted output.
Print option: opens browser print dialog with a formatted view of the stock items grid.
Export option: downloads a CSV or PDF of the items grid.
Exported data includes all visible grid columns.
Deleted items (LineStatus = 'Deleted') are excluded from export.
Export file name format: 'RO-{repairOrderId}-Items-{date}.csv'.
stories.narrative: Users can print or export the stock items list for physical records or external processing.
stories.design_notes: Print button and Export button in grid toolbar. Export format: CSV. File name: RO-{id}-Items-{date}.csv. Browser print dialog for Print. Deleted items excluded.
